because he has won a glorious victory[b].

public_domain_references.kjv: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help with him.
public_domain_references.brenton: And if thou see thine enemy's ass fallen under its burden, thou shalt not pass by it, but shalt help to raise it with him.

pob.text: You shall not pervert the justice due to your poor person in his dispute[a].

spob.text: Do not deny a poor person the justice they are due in their legal case.

public_domain_references.bsb: You shall not deny justice to the poor in their lawsuits.
public_domain_references.web: “You shall not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.
public_domain_references.asv: Thou shalt not wrest the justice [due] to thy poor in his cause.
public_domain_references.kjv: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause.
public_domain_references.brenton: Thou shalt not wrest the sentence of the poor in his judgment.

pob.text: Keep far from a false matter[a], and do not kill the innocent and the righteous[b], for I will not justify the wicked.

spob.text: Stay far away from falsehood.[a] Do not kill innocent people or those who are in the right, because I will not declare the wicked to be righteous.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Stay far away from a false accusation. Do not kill the innocent or the just, for I will not acquit the guilty.
public_domain_references.web: “Keep far from a false charge, and don’t kill the innocent and righteous; for I will not justify the wicked.
public_domain_references.asv: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.
public_domain_references.kjv: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.
public_domain_references.brenton: Thou shalt abstain from every unjust thing: thou shalt not slay the innocent and just, and thou shalt not justify the wicked for gifts.

pob.text: And you shall not take a bribe[b][a], for a bribe blinds the clear-sighted and twists the words of the righteous.

spob.text: Do not accept a bribe. A bribe blinds those who see clearly[a] and twists the words of the righteous.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds those who see and twists the words of the righteous.
public_domain_references.web: “You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.
public_domain_references.asv: And thou shalt take no bribe: for a bribe blindeth them that have sight, and perverteth the words of the righteous.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And thou shalt take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous.
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou shalt not receive gifts; for gifts blind the eyes of the seeing, and corrupt just words.

pob.text: You shall not oppress a sojourner[a], and you yourselves know the soul of the sojourner[b], because you were sojourners in the land of Egypt.

spob.text: Do not oppress a foreigner living among you.[a] You yourselves know what it is like to be a foreigner, because you were foreigners in Egypt.

public_domain_references.bsb: Do not oppress a foreign resident, since you yourselves know how it feels to be foreigners; for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.
public_domain_references.web: “You shall not oppress an alien, for you know the heart of an alien, since you were aliens in the land of Egypt.
public_domain_references.asv: And a sojourner shalt thou not oppress: for ye know the heart of a sojourner, seeing ye were sojourners in the land of Egypt.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger: for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
public_domain_references.brenton: And ye shall not afflict a stranger, for ye know the heart of a stranger; for ye were yourselves strangers in the land of Egypt.

pob.text: For six years you shall sow your land and gather its produce[a].

spob.text: For six years, plant seed in your land and gather what it produces.

public_domain_references.bsb: For six years you are to sow your land and gather its produce,
public_domain_references.web: “For six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in its increase,
public_domain_references.asv: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in the increase thereof:
public_domain_references.kjv: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in the fruits thereof:
public_domain_references.brenton: Six years thou shalt sow thy land, and gather in the fruits of it.

pob.text: But in the seventh year you shall let it rest and leave it alone[a], so that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave, the wild animals of the field may eat[b]. You shall do the same with your vineyard and your olive grove.

spob.text: But in the seventh year, let the land rest and leave it uncultivated, so that the poor among your people may eat from it. The wild animals may eat what they leave. Do the same with your vineyard and your olive grove.

public_domain_references.bsb: but in the seventh year you must let it rest and lie fallow, so that the poor among your people may eat from the field and the wild animals may consume what they leave. Do the same with your vineyard and olive grove.
public_domain_references.web: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave the animal of the field shall eat. In the same way, you shall deal with your vineyard and with your olive grove.
public_domain_references.asv: but the seventh year thou shalt let it rest and lie fallow; that the poor of thy people may eat: and what they leave the beast of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, [and] with thy oliveyard.
public_domain_references.kjv: But the seventh [year] thou shalt let it rest and lie still; that the poor of thy people may eat: and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, [and] with thy oliveyard.
public_domain_references.brenton: But in the seventh year thou shalt let it rest, and leave it, and the poor of thy nation shall feed; and the wild beasts of the field shall eat that which remains: thus shalt thou do to thy vineyard and to thine oliveyard.

pob.text: For six days you shall do your work[a], but on the seventh day you shall cease, so that your ox and your donkey may rest[c][b], and the son of your female servant and the sojourner may be refreshed.

spob.text: Do your work for six days, but stop working on the seventh day so that your ox and donkey may rest, and your female servant’s son and the resident foreigner may be refreshed.

public_domain_references.bsb: For six days you are to do your work, but on the seventh day you must cease, so that your ox and your donkey may rest and the son of your maidservant may be refreshed, as well as the foreign resident.
public_domain_references.web: “Six days you shall do your work, and on the seventh day you shall rest, that your ox and your donkey may have rest, and the son of your servant, and the alien may be refreshed.
public_domain_references.asv: Six days thou shalt do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest; that thine ox and thine ass may have rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the sojourner, may be refreshed.
public_domain_references.kjv: Six days thou shalt do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest: that thine ox and thine ass may rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.
public_domain_references.brenton: Six days shalt thou do thy works, and on the seventh day there shall be rest, that thine ox and thine ass may rest, and that the son of thy maid-servant and the stranger may be refreshed.

pob.text: In all that I have said to you[a], be careful[b]; and the name of other gods you shall not mention—it shall not be heard on your lips.

spob.text: Be careful to follow everything I have told you. Do not mention[a] the names of other gods. Do not let their names be heard on your lips.

public_domain_references.bsb: Pay close attention to everything I have said to you. You must not invoke the names of other gods; they must not be heard on your lips.
public_domain_references.web: “Be careful to do all things that I have said to you; and don’t invoke the name of other gods or even let them be heard out of your mouth.
public_domain_references.asv: And in all things that I have said unto you take ye heed: and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of thy mouth.
public_domain_references.kjv: And in all [things] that I have said unto you be circumspect: and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of thy mouth.
public_domain_references.brenton: Observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you; and ye shall make no mention of the name of other gods, neither shall they be heard out of your mouth.

pob.text: Three times in the year you shall keep a feast to me[a].

spob.text: Three times each year, you must celebrate a festival for me.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Three times a year you are to celebrate a feast to Me.
public_domain_references.web: “You shall observe a feast to me three times a year.
public_domain_references.asv: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year.
public_domain_references.brenton: Keep ye a feast to me three times in the year.

pob.text: You shall keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread[a]. For seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the appointed time in the month of Abib, for in it you came out from Egypt[b]. And no one shall appear before me empty-handed.

spob.text: Observe the Feast of Unleavened Bread. For seven days, eat bread made without anything that makes it rise, as I commanded you. Observe the feast at the appointed time in the month of Abib,[a] because that was the month when you left Egypt. No one may appear before me empty-handed.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: You are to keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread as I commanded you: At the appointed time in the month of Abib you are to eat unleavened bread for seven days, because that was the month you came out of Egypt. No one may appear before Me empty-handed.
public_domain_references.web: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib (for in it you came out of Egypt), and no one shall appear before me empty.
public_domain_references.asv: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep: seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, as I commanded thee, at the time appointed in the month Abib (for in it thou camest out from Egypt); and none shall appear before me empty:
public_domain_references.kjv: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded thee, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it thou camest out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:)
public_domain_references.brenton: Take heed to keep the feast of unleavened bread: seven days ye shall eat unleavened bread, as I charged thee at the season of the month of new [corn], for in it thou camest out of Egypt: thou shalt not appear before me empty.

pob.text: and the Feast of Harvest[a], the firstfruits of your labors, of what you sow in the field; and the Feast of Ingathering at the end of the year[c][b], when you gather in your labors from the field.

spob.text: Also observe the Feast of Harvest, the festival of your firstfruits—the first produce from what you sow in the field. Observe the Feast of Ingathering at the end of the year, when you gather from the field what your work has produced.

public_domain_references.bsb: You are also to keep the Feast of Harvest with the firstfruits of the produce from what you sow in the field. And keep the Feast of Ingathering at the end of the year, when you gather your produce from the field.
public_domain_references.web: And the feast of harvest, the first fruits of your labors, which you sow in the field; and the feast of ingathering, at the end of the year, when you gather in your labors out of the field.
public_domain_references.asv: and the feast of harvest, the first-fruits of thy labors, which thou sowest in the field: and the feast of ingathering, at the end of the year, when thou gatherest in thy labors out of the field.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the feast of harvest, the firstfruits of thy labours, which thou hast sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering, [which is] in the end of the year, when thou hast gathered in thy labours out of the field.
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou shalt keep the feast of the harvest of first-fruits of thy labours, whatsoever thou shalt have sown in thy field, and the feast of completion at the end of the year in the gathering in of thy fruits out of thy field.

pob.text: Three times in the year every male among you shall appear before the Lord Yahweh[a].

spob.text: Three times each year, every male among you must come before the Lord Yahweh.

public_domain_references.bsb: Three times a year all your males are to appear before the Lord GOD.
public_domain_references.web: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord Yahweh.
public_domain_references.asv: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord Jehovah.
public_domain_references.kjv: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord GOD.
public_domain_references.brenton: Three times in the year shall all thy males appear before the Lord thy God.

pob.text: You shall not sacrifice the blood of my sacrifice with anything leavened[b][a], and the fat of my feast shall not remain until morning.

spob.text: Do not offer the blood of my sacrifice together with anything leavened.[a] Do not leave the fat of my feast until morning.

public_domain_references.bsb: You must not offer the blood of My sacrifices with anything leavened, nor may the fat of My feast remain until morning.
public_domain_references.web: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The fat of my feast shall not remain all night until the morning.
public_domain_references.asv: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my feast remain all night until the morning.
public_domain_references.kjv: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.
public_domain_references.brenton: For when I shall have cast out the nations from before thee, and shall have widened thy borders, thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven, neither must the fat of my feast abide till the morning.

pob.text: The first of the firstfruits of your ground you shall bring into the house of Yahweh your God[b][a]. You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.

spob.text: Bring the first portion of the earliest produce from your ground to the house of Yahweh your God.[a] Do not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.

public_domain_references.bsb: Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the LORD your God. You must not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk.
public_domain_references.web: You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground into the house of Yahweh your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.
public_domain_references.asv: The first of the first-fruits of thy ground thou shalt bring into the house of Jehovah thy God. Thou shalt not boil a kid in its mother’s milk.
public_domain_references.kjv: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.
public_domain_references.brenton: Thou shalt bring the first-offerings of the first-fruits of thy land into the house of the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a lamb in its mother's milk.

pob.text: Behold[a], I am sending an angel before you to guard you on the way and to bring you to the place that I have prepared.

spob.text: Look! I am sending an angel[a] ahead of you to guard you on your journey. The angel will bring you to the place I have prepared.

public_domain_references.bsb: Behold, I am sending an angel before you to protect you along the way and to bring you to the place I have prepared.
public_domain_references.web: “Behold, I send an angel before you, to keep you by the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.
public_domain_references.asv: Behold, I send an angel before thee, to keep thee by the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.
public_domain_references.brenton: And, behold, I send my angel before thy face, that he may keep thee in the way, that he may bring thee into the land which I have prepared for thee.

pob.text: Be on your guard before him[a], and listen to his voice. Do not rebel against him, for he will not pardon your transgression, because my name is within him.

spob.text: Be on your guard before him, and listen to what he says. Do not rebel against him. He will not pardon your transgression, because my name is within him.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Pay attention to him and listen to his voice; do not defy him, for he will not forgive rebellion, since My Name is in him.
public_domain_references.web: Pay attention to him, and listen to his voice. Don’t provoke him, for he will not pardon your disobedience, for my name is in him.
public_domain_references.asv: Take ye heed before him, and hearken unto his voice; provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgression: for my name is in him.
public_domain_references.kjv: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name [is] in him.
public_domain_references.brenton: Take heed to thyself and hearken to him, and disobey him not; for he will not give way to thee, for my name is on him.

pob.text: But if you carefully obey his voice and do all that I speak[b][a], then I will be an enemy to your enemies and an adversary to your adversaries.

spob.text: But if you listen carefully to his voice and obey him, and do everything I say,[a] I will be an enemy to your enemies and oppose those who oppose you.

public_domain_references.bsb: But if you will listen carefully to his voice and do everything I say, I will be an enemy to your enemies and a foe to your foes.
public_domain_references.web: But if you indeed listen to his voice, and do all that I speak, then I will be an enemy to your enemies, and an adversary to your adversaries.
public_domain_references.asv: But if thou shalt indeed hearken unto his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries.
public_domain_references.kjv: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries.
public_domain_references.brenton: If ye will indeed hear my voice, and if thou wilt do all the things I shall charge thee with, and keep my covenant, ye shall be to me a peculiar people above all nations, for the whole earth is mine; and ye shall be to me a royal priesthood, and a holy nation: these words shall ye speak to the children of Israel, If ye shall indeed hear my voice, and do all the things I shall tell thee, I will be an enemy to thine enemies, and an adversary to thine adversaries.

pob.text: For my angel will go before you and bring you to the Amorites[a], the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites[b], and I will wipe them out.

spob.text: For my angel[a] will go ahead of you and bring you to the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites. Then I will wipe those peoples out.

public_domain_references.bsb: For My angel will go before you and bring you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I will annihilate them.
public_domain_references.web: For my angel shall go before you, and bring you in to the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I will cut them off.
public_domain_references.asv: For mine angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Canaanite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite: and I will cut them off.
public_domain_references.kjv: For mine Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.
public_domain_references.brenton: For my angel shall go as thy leader, and shall bring thee to the Amorite, and Chettite, and Pherezite, and Chananite, and Gergesite, and Evite, and Jebusite, and I will destroy them.

pob.text: You shall not bow down to their gods[a], nor serve them, nor do according to their deeds; rather, you shall surely tear them down and surely shatter their pillars.

spob.text: Do not bow down to their gods or serve them. Do not follow their worship practices. Instead, completely tear down the objects used in their worship and shatter their sacred stone pillars.

public_domain_references.bsb: You must not bow down to their gods or serve them or follow their practices. Instead, you are to demolish them and smash their sacred stones to pieces.
public_domain_references.web: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor follow their practices, but you shall utterly overthrow them and demolish their pillars.
public_domain_references.asv: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works; but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and break in pieces their pillars.
public_domain_references.kjv: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works: but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images.
public_domain_references.brenton: Thou shalt not worship their gods, nor serve them: thou shalt not do according to their works, but shalt utterly destroy them, and break to pieces their pillars.

pob.text: You shall serve Yahweh your God[a], and he will bless your bread and your water[b], and I will remove sickness from your midst.

spob.text: Serve Yahweh your God. He will bless your food and water, and I will remove sickness from among you.

public_domain_references.bsb: So you shall serve the LORD your God, and He will bless your bread and your water. And I will take away sickness from among you.
public_domain_references.web: You shall serve Yahweh your God, and he will bless your bread and your water, and I will take sickness away from among you.
public_domain_references.asv: And ye shall serve Jehovah your God, and he will bless thy bread, and thy water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.
public_domain_references.kjv: And ye shall serve the LORD your God, and he shall bless thy bread, and thy water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou shalt serve the Lord thy God, and I will bless thy bread and thy wine and thy water, and I will turn away sickness from you.

pob.text: There shall not be one miscarrying or barren in your land[b][a]; I will fill up the number of your days.

spob.text: No woman in your land will miscarry[a] or be unable to have children. I will bring your days to their full measure.

public_domain_references.bsb: No woman in your land will miscarry or be barren; I will fulfill the number of your days.
public_domain_references.web: No one will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will fulfill the number of your days.
public_domain_references.asv: There shall none cast her young, nor be barren, in thy land: the number of thy days I will fulfil.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in thy land: the number of thy days I will fulfil.
public_domain_references.brenton: There shall not be on thy land one that is impotent or barren. I will surely fulfil the number of thy days.

pob.text: I will send my terror ahead of you[a], and I will throw into confusion all the people among whom you come[c][b], and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.

spob.text: I will send my terror[a] ahead of you. I will throw all the people you encounter into confusion, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs and flee from you.

public_domain_references.bsb: I will send My terror ahead of you and throw into confusion every nation you encounter. I will make all your enemies turn and run.
public_domain_references.web: I will send my terror before you, and will confuse all the people to whom you come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.
public_domain_references.asv: I will send my terror before thee, and will discomfit all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee.
public_domain_references.kjv: I will send my fear before thee, and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee.
public_domain_references.brenton: And I will send terror before thee, and I will strike with amazement all the nations to which thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies to flee.

pob.text: And I will send the hornet ahead of you[a], and it will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite from before you.

spob.text: I will send the hornet[a] ahead of you. It will drive the Hivites, Canaanites, and Hittites out of your path.

public_domain_references.bsb: I will send the hornet before you to drive the Hivites and Canaanites and Hittites out of your way.
public_domain_references.web: I will send the hornet before you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.
public_domain_references.asv: And I will send the hornet before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.
public_domain_references.kjv: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.
public_domain_references.brenton: And I will send hornets before thee, and thou shalt cast out the Amorites and the Evites, and the Chananites and the Chettites from thee.

pob.text: I will not drive them out from before you in one year[b][a], lest the land become desolate and the wild animals of the field become too numerous against you.

spob.text: I will not drive them out from the land before you in a single year. Otherwise, the land would become desolate, and the wild animals would become too numerous and threaten you.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: I will not drive them out before you in a single year; otherwise the land would become desolate and wild animals would multiply against you.
public_domain_references.web: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the animals of the field multiply against you.
public_domain_references.asv: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the beasts of the field multiply against thee.
public_domain_references.kjv: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against thee.
public_domain_references.brenton: I will not cast them out in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the beasts of the field multiply against thee.

pob.text: Little by little I will drive them out from before you[b][a], until you become fruitful and take possession of the land.

spob.text: Little by little I will drive them[a] out of your way, until you grow in number and take possession of the land.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Little by little I will drive them out ahead of you, until you become fruitful and possess the land.
public_domain_references.web: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and inherit the land.
public_domain_references.asv: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased, and inherit the land.
public_domain_references.kjv: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased, and inherit the land.
public_domain_references.brenton: By little [and little] I will cast them out from before thee, until thou shalt be increased and inherit the earth.

pob.text: And I will set your border from the Red Sea to the Sea of the Philistines[a], and from the wilderness to the River; for I will give the inhabitants of the land into your hand[b], and you will drive them out from before you.

public_domain_references.web: The stones shall be according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, they shall be for the twelve tribes.
public_domain_references.asv: And the stones shall be according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, every one according to his name, they shall be for the twelve tribes.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, [like] the engravings of a signet; every one with his name shall they be according to the twelve tribes.
public_domain_references.brenton: And let the stones of the names of the children of Israel be twelve according to their names, engravings as of seals: let them be for the twelve tribes each according to the name.

pob.text: And you shall make on the breastpiece chains of pure gold[a], braided work like cords.

spob.text: For the breastpiece, make pure gold chains braided like cords.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: For the breastpiece, make braided chains like cords of pure gold.

public_domain_references.asv: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains like cords, of wreathen work of pure gold.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains at the ends [of] wreathen work [of] pure gold.
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou shalt make on the oracle woven fringes, a chain-work of pure gold.

pob.text: You shall make two gold rings on the breastpiece[b][a], and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastpiece.

spob.text: Make two gold rings and attach them to the two ends of the breastpiece.

public_domain_references.bsb: You are also to make two gold rings and fasten them to the two corners of the breastpiece.
public_domain_references.web: You shall make on the breastplate two rings of gold, and shall put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
public_domain_references.asv: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate two rings of gold, and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
public_domain_references.kjv: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate two rings of gold, and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

pob.text: And you shall put the two braided chains of gold on the two rings[b][a], at the ends of the breastpiece.

spob.text: Attach the two braided gold chains to the two rings at the ends of the breastpiece.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Then fasten the two gold chains to the two gold rings at the corners of the breastpiece,
public_domain_references.web: You shall put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.
public_domain_references.asv: And thou shalt put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.
public_domain_references.kjv: And thou shalt put the two wreathen [chains] of gold in the two rings [which are] on the ends of the breastplate.

pob.text: And you shall put the two ends of the two cords on the two settings[a], and you shall place them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod, at its front.

spob.text: Attach the ends of the two cords to the two settings. Then fasten the two settings to the front of the ephod’s shoulder pieces.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: and fasten the other ends of the two chains to the two filigree settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.
public_domain_references.web: The other two ends of the two braided chains you shall put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod in its forepart.
public_domain_references.asv: And the [other] two ends of the two wreathen chains thou shalt put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod in the forepart thereof.
public_domain_references.kjv: And [the other] two ends of the two wreathen [chains] thou shalt fasten in the two ouches, and put [them] on the shoulderpieces of the ephod before it.

pob.text: You shall make two gold rings and put them on the two ends of the breastpiece[a], on its edge that is toward the inner side of the ephod.

spob.text: Make two gold rings. Put them at the two ends of the breastpiece, on its inner edge next to the ephod.

public_domain_references.bsb: Make two more gold rings and attach them to the other two corners of the breastpiece, on the inside edge next to the ephod.
public_domain_references.web: You shall make two rings of gold, and you shall put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which is toward the side of the ephod inward.
public_domain_references.asv: And thou shalt make two rings of gold, and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate, upon the edge thereof, which is toward the side of the ephod inward.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And thou shalt make two rings of gold, and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate in the border thereof, which [is] in the side of the ephod inward.

pob.text: You shall make two rings of gold and put them on the two shoulder-pieces of the ephod[a], underneath, on its front side, opposite its seam[b], above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

spob.text: Make two gold rings. Attach them to the lower part of the ephod’s two shoulder-pieces, on the front side, across from where the ephod is joined, and above its skillfully woven band. The ephod is the priestly garment.

public_domain_references.bsb: Make two additional gold rings and attach them to the bottom of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, on its front, near its seam just above its woven waistband.
public_domain_references.web: You shall make two rings of gold, and shall put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its forepart, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.
public_domain_references.asv: And thou shalt make two rings of gold, and shalt put them on the two shoulder-pieces of the ephod underneath, in the forepart thereof, close by the coupling thereof, above the skilfully woven band of the ephod.
public_domain_references.kjv: And two [other] rings of gold thou shalt make, and shalt put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart thereof, over against the [other] coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.

pob.text: They shall bind the breastpiece by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a cord of blue yarn[a], so that it may be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod[c][b], and the breastpiece shall not come loose from the ephod.

spob.text: Use a cord of blue yarn to fasten the breastpiece rings to the rings on the priestly garment called the ephod. This will hold the breastpiece on the ephod’s skillfully woven band and keep it from coming loose from the ephod.

public_domain_references.bsb: The rings of the breastpiece shall be tied to the rings of the ephod with a cord of blue yarn, so that the breastpiece is above the waistband of the ephod and does not swing out from the ephod.
public_domain_references.web: They shall bind the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate may not swing out from the ephod.
public_domain_references.asv: And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be upon the skilfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod.
public_domain_references.kjv: And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that [it] may be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod.

pob.text: Aaron shall carry the names of the sons of Israel in the breastpiece of judgment over his heart when he goes into the Holy Place[d][c][b][a], for a memorial before Yahweh continually.

spob.text: Whenever Aaron enters the Holy Place, he must carry the names of the sons of Israel over his heart in the breastpiece of judgment.[a][b] This will be a continual memorial before Yahweh.

public_domain_references.bsb: Whenever Aaron enters the Holy Place, he shall bear the names of the sons of Israel over his heart on the breastpiece of judgment, as a continual reminder before the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment on his heart, when he goes in to the holy place, for a memorial before Yahweh continually.
public_domain_references.asv: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart, when he goeth in unto the holy place, for a memorial before Jehovah continually.
public_domain_references.kjv: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart, when he goeth in unto the holy [place], for a memorial before the LORD continually.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Aaron shall take the names of the children of Israel, on the oracle of judgment on his breast; a memorial before God for him as he goes into the sanctuary.

pob.text: And you shall put the Urim and the Thummim into the breastpiece of judgment[a], and they shall be on Aaron’s heart when he goes in before Yahweh[c][b]. And Aaron shall bear the judgment of the sons of Israel on his heart before Yahweh continually.

spob.text: Put the Urim and Thummim[a] into the breastpiece of judgment.[b] They will be on Aaron’s heart when he goes in before Yahweh. Aaron will continually carry on his heart the judgment concerning the sons of Israel.[c]

public_domain_references.bsb: And place the Urim and Thummim in the breastpiece of judgment, so that they will also be over Aaron’s heart whenever he comes before the LORD. Aaron will continually carry the judgment of the sons of Israel over his heart before the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: You shall put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be on Aaron’s heart, when he goes in before Yahweh. Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel on his heart before Yahweh continually.
public_domain_references.asv: And thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be upon Aaron’s heart, when he goeth in before Jehovah: and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before Jehovah continually.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be upon Aaron’s heart, when he goeth in before the LORD: and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before the LORD continually.
public_domain_references.brenton: and thou shalt put the two circlets on both the shoulders of the ephod in front. And thou shalt put the Manifestation and the Truth on the oracle of judgment; and it shall be on the breast of Aaron, when he goes into the holy place before the Lord; and Aaron shall bear the judgments of the children of Israel on his breast before the Lord continually.

pob.text: You shall make the robe of the ephod entirely of blue[a][b].

spob.text: Make the robe that goes with the ephod entirely from blue material.[a][b]

public_domain_references.bsb: You are to make the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth,
public_domain_references.web: “You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.
public_domain_references.asv: And thou shalt make the robe of the ephod all of blue.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And thou shalt make the robe of the ephod all [of] blue.
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou shalt make the full-length tunic all of blue.

pob.text: Its opening for the head shall be in the middle of it; around its opening there shall be a woven edge[a], like the opening of a coat of mail, so that it may not be torn.

spob.text: The robe’s opening for the head must be in the center. It must have a woven border all around the opening, like the opening of a coat of mail,[a] so that it does not tear.

public_domain_references.bsb: with an opening at its top in the center. Around the opening shall be a woven collar with an opening like that of a garment, so that it will not tear.
public_domain_references.web: It shall have a hole for the head in the middle of it. It shall have a binding of woven work around its hole, as it were the hole of a coat of mail, that it not be torn.
public_domain_references.asv: And it shall have a hole for the head in the midst thereof: it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it, as it were the hole of a coat of mail, that it be not rent.
public_domain_references.kjv: And there shall be an hole in the top of it, in the midst thereof: it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it, as it were the hole of an habergeon, that it be not rent.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the opening of it shall be in the middle having a fringe round about the opening, the work of the weaver, woven together in the joining of the same piece that it might not be rent.

pob.text: You shall make on its hem pomegranates of blue and purple and scarlet yarn[a], all around its hem, with bells of gold between them all around.

spob.text: Make pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn[a] all around the hem of the robe, with gold bells between them all around.

public_domain_references.bsb: Make pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn all the way around the lower hem, with gold bells between them,
public_domain_references.web: On its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, all around its hem; with bells of gold between and around them:
public_domain_references.asv: And upon the skirts of it thou shalt make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, round about the skirts thereof; and bells of gold between them round about:
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And [beneath] upon the hem of it thou shalt make pomegranates [of] blue, and [of] purple, and [of] scarlet, round about the hem thereof; and bells of gold between them round about:
public_domain_references.brenton: And under the fringe of the robe below thou shalt make as it were pomegranates of a flowering pomegranate tree, of blue, and purple, and spun scarlet, and fine linen spun, under the fringe of the robe round about: golden pomegranates of the same shape, and bells round about between these.

pob.text: a gold bell and a pomegranate[a], a gold bell and a pomegranate[b], around the hem of the robe all around.

spob.text: A gold bell, then a pomegranate-shaped ornament, then another gold bell and another ornament—alternating all around the hem of the robe.

public_domain_references.bsb: alternating the gold bells and pomegranates around the lower hem of the robe.
public_domain_references.web: a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, around the hem of the robe.
public_domain_references.asv: a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, upon the skirts of the robe round about.
public_domain_references.kjv: A golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, upon the hem of the robe round about.
public_domain_references.brenton: A bell by the side of a golden pomegranate, and flower-work on the fringe of the robe round about.

pob.text: It shall be on Aaron when he ministers[a], and its sound shall be heard when he goes into the Holy Place before Yahweh and when he comes out[c][b], so that he may not die.

spob.text: Aaron must wear the robe when he serves. The sound of its bells must be heard when he enters the Holy Place before Yahweh and when he comes out, so that he may not die.

public_domain_references.bsb: Aaron must wear the robe whenever he ministers, and its sound will be heard when he enters or exits the sanctuary before the LORD, so that he will not die.
public_domain_references.web: It shall be on Aaron to minister: and its sound shall be heard when he goes in to the holy place before Yahweh, and when he comes out, that he not die.
public_domain_references.asv: And it shall be upon Aaron to minister: and the sound thereof shall be heard when he goeth in unto the holy place before Jehovah, and when he cometh out, that he die not.
public_domain_references.kjv: And it shall be upon Aaron to minister: and his sound shall be heard when he goeth in unto the holy [place] before the LORD, and when he cometh out, that he die not.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the sound of Aaron shall be audible when he ministers, as he goes into the sanctuary before the Lord, and as he goes out, that he die not.

pob.text: And you shall make a plate of pure gold[a], and engrave on it, like the engravings of a seal: ‘Holy to Yahweh.’

spob.text: Make a plate of pure gold. Engrave these words on it in the style of a seal: “Holy to Yahweh.”[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: You are to make a plate of pure gold and engrave on it as on a seal: HOLY TO THE LORD.
public_domain_references.web: “You shall make a plate of pure gold, and engrave on it, like the engravings of a signet, ‘HOLY TO YAHWEH.’
public_domain_references.asv: And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold, and grave upon it, like the engravings of a signet, HOLY TO JEHOVAH.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And thou shalt make a plate [of] pure gold, and grave upon it, [like] the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou shalt make a plate [of] pure gold, and thou shalt grave on it [as] the graving of a signet, Holiness of the Lord.

pob.text: And you shall put it on a cord of blue[a], and it shall be on the turban[b]; it shall be at the front of the turban.

spob.text: Fasten it to a blue cord. It is to be on the front of the turban.

public_domain_references.bsb: Fasten to it a blue cord to mount it on the turban; it shall be on the front of the turban.
public_domain_references.web: You shall put it on a lace of blue, and it shall be on the sash. It shall be on the front of the sash.
public_domain_references.asv: And thou shalt put it on a lace of blue, and it shall be upon the mitre; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be.
public_domain_references.kjv: And thou shalt put it on a blue lace, that it may be upon the mitre; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be.
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou shalt put it on the spun blue cloth, and it shall be on the mitre: it shall be in the front of the mitre.

pob.text: It shall be on Aaron’s forehead[a], and Aaron shall bear the iniquity of the holy things that the sons of Israel consecrate, for all the gifts of their holy things. It shall always be on his forehead[c][b], for acceptance for them before Yahweh.

spob.text: It must be on Aaron’s forehead. Aaron will bear the guilt connected with all the holy gifts that the Israelites set apart for God.[a] It must always be on his forehead, so that they may be accepted before Yahweh.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: And it will be worn on Aaron’s forehead, so that he may bear the iniquity of the holy things that the sons of Israel consecrate with regard to all their holy gifts. It shall always be on his forehead, so that they may be acceptable before the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: It shall be on Aaron’s forehead, and Aaron shall bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall make holy in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always on his forehead, that they may be accepted before Yahweh.
public_domain_references.asv: And it shall be upon Aaron’s forehead, and Aaron shall bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always upon his forehead, that they may be accepted before Jehovah.
public_domain_references.kjv: And it shall be upon Aaron’s forehead, that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always upon his forehead, that they may be accepted before the LORD.
public_domain_references.brenton: And it shall be on the forehead of Aaron; and Aaron shall bear away the sins of their holy things, all that the children of Israel shall sanctify of every gift of their holy things, and it shall be on the forehead of Aaron continually acceptable for them before the Lord.

pob.text: You shall weave the tunic in checker work of fine linen[a], and you shall make a turban of fine linen, and you shall make a sash, the work of an embroiderer.

spob.text: Make the fine linen tunic with a checkered woven pattern. Also make a fine linen turban and an embroidered sash.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: You are to weave the tunic with fine linen, make the turban of fine linen, and fashion an embroidered sash.
public_domain_references.web: You shall weave the tunic with fine linen. You shall make a turban of fine linen. You shall make a sash, the work of the embroiderer.
public_domain_references.asv: And thou shalt weave the coat in checker work of fine linen, and thou shalt make a mitre of fine linen, and thou shalt make a girdle, the work of the embroiderer.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And thou shalt embroider the coat of fine linen, and thou shalt make the mitre [of] fine linen, and thou shalt make the girdle [of] needlework.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the fringes of the garments [shall be] of fine linen; and thou shalt make a tire of fine linen, and thou shalt make a girdle, the work of the embroiderer.

pob.text: For Aaron’s sons you shall make tunics[a], and you shall make sashes for them, and you shall make caps for them, for glory and for beauty.

spob.text: Make tunics, cloth waist sashes, and priestly head coverings[a] for Aaron’s sons. These garments are to honor them and make them look beautiful.

public_domain_references.bsb: Make tunics, sashes, and headbands for Aaron’s sons, to give them glory and splendor.
public_domain_references.web: “You shall make tunics for Aaron’s sons. You shall make sashes for them. You shall make headbands for them, for glory and for beauty.
public_domain_references.asv: And for Aaron’s sons thou shalt make coats, and thou shalt make for them girdles, and head-tires shalt thou make for them, for glory and for beauty.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And for Aaron’s sons thou shalt make coats, and thou shalt make for them girdles, and bonnets shalt thou make for them, for glory and for beauty.
public_domain_references.brenton: And for the sons of Aaron thou shalt make tunics and girdles, and thou shalt make for them tires for honour and glory.

pob.text: You shall clothe Aaron your brother and his sons with him[a], and you shall anoint them and ordain them and consecrate them, and they shall serve as priests to me.

spob.text: Dress your brother Aaron and his sons. Anoint them, ordain them[a], and set them apart as holy. They will serve me as priests.

public_domain_references.bsb: After you put these garments on your brother Aaron and his sons, anoint them, ordain them, and consecrate them so that they may serve Me as priests.
public_domain_references.web: You shall put them on Aaron your brother, and on his sons with him, and shall anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.
public_domain_references.asv: And thou shalt put them upon Aaron thy brother, and upon his sons with him, and shalt anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office.
public_domain_references.kjv: And thou shalt put them upon Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him; and shalt anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office.
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou shalt put them on Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him, and thou shalt anoint them and fill their hands: and thou shalt sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest's office.

pob.text: And make for them linen undergarments to cover their naked flesh[b][a]; they shall be from the hips to the thighs.

spob.text: Make linen undergarments for them to cover their naked bodies. The garments must reach from the hips to the thighs.

public_domain_references.bsb: Make linen undergarments to cover their bare flesh, extending from waist to thigh.
public_domain_references.web: You shall make them linen pants to cover their naked flesh. They shall reach from the waist even to the thighs.
public_domain_references.asv: And thou shalt make them linen breeches to cover the flesh of their nakedness; from the loins even unto the thighs they shall reach:
public_domain_references.kjv: And thou shalt make them linen breeches to cover their nakedness; from the loins even unto the thighs they shall reach:
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou shalt make for them linen drawers to cover the nakedness of their flesh; they shall reach from the loins to the thighs.

pob.text: And they shall be on Aaron and on his sons when they enter the tent of meeting[a], or when they approach the altar to minister in the holy place, so that they may not bear guilt and die[b]. It shall be a permanent statute for him and for his offspring after him.

spob.text: Aaron and his sons must wear these garments when they enter the tent of meeting or approach the altar to serve in the holy place. Otherwise, they will incur guilt and die. This requirement will remain in force for Aaron and his descendants after him.

public_domain_references.bsb: Aaron and his sons must wear them whenever they enter the Tent of Meeting or approach the altar to minister in the Holy Place, so that they will not incur guilt and die. This is to be a permanent statute for Aaron and his descendants.
public_domain_references.web: They shall be on Aaron and on his sons, when they go in to the Tent of Meeting, or when they come near to the altar to minister in the holy place, that they don’t bear iniquity, and die. This shall be a statute forever to him and to his offspring after him.
public_domain_references.asv: and they shall be upon Aaron, and upon his sons, when they go in unto the tent of meeting, or when they come near unto the altar to minister in the holy place; that they bear not iniquity, and die: it shall be a statute for ever unto him and unto his seed after him.
public_domain_references.kjv: And they shall be upon Aaron, and upon his sons, when they come in unto the tabernacle of the congregation, or when they come near unto the altar to minister in the holy [place;] that they bear not iniquity, and die: [it shall be] a statute for ever unto him and his seed after him.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Aaron shall have them, and his sons, whenever they enter into the tabernacle of witness, or when they shall advance to the altar of the sanctuary to minister, so they shall not bring sin upon themselves, lest they die: [it is] a perpetual statute for him, and for his seed after him.

pob.text: And this is the thing that you shall do for them to consecrate them to serve as priests for me: take one bull from the herd and two unblemished rams[a][b].

spob.text: This is what you must do to set them apart to serve as priests for me: Take one bull from the herd[a] and two rams with no defects.

public_domain_references.asv: And this is the thing that thou shalt do unto them to hallow them, to minister unto me in the priest’s office: take one young bullock and two rams without blemish,
public_domain_references.kjv: And this [is] the thing that thou shalt do unto them to hallow them, to minister unto me in the priest’s office: Take one young bullock, and two rams without blemish,
public_domain_references.brenton: And these are the things which thou shalt do to them: thou shalt sanctify them, so that they shall serve me in the priesthood; and thou shalt take one young calf from the herd, and two unblemished rams;

pob.text: and unleavened bread[a], and unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers spread with oil[b]; you shall make them of fine wheat flour.
